entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit customer service, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. My order number is VF789012.

Thank you for that, I'm pulling up your order now... I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 19 days ago. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical thing. It's just not working right. The heart rate tracking is completely inaccurate. Honestly, I think the device is just a piece of garbage.

Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that it's not performing as expected. That sounds incredibly frustrating. I can definitely try to help you with that. Often, sensor inaccuracies can be fixed with a quick reset or a software patch. Would you be open to me walking you through a couple of quick troubleshooting steps?
Ugh, no. I really don't have time for all that. I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this and it's defective. I just want a refund.

I understand you're busy, and I want to respect your time. However, to process a return for a defect outside the initial 10-day return window, our policy requires us to first verify the fault with our technical team. The steps are very quick and usually resolve these kinds of issues.

I can't believe this. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I've bought jerseys, shorts... everything. I really needed this to work, and now I'm out the money. I just want my money back for a broken product.

We sincerely appreciate your loyalty, and I assure you this isn't the experience we want for our customers. The policy is in place because after 10 days, the VeloBand Pulse gets permanently linked to a user's account for health data tracking. Without being able to troubleshoot and verify a hardware defect, I'm unable to authorize a return at 19 days.
So I'm just stuck with this expensive piece of garbage? I'm just so let down. I really needed that money for bills this month.

I truly wish there was more I could do. Since we can't process the return without technical verification, the next best option might be our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform where customers can sell their gear to other enthusiasts. If it's a software issue we could fix, you'd still have a fully functional device.
The marketplace... great. So I have to do the work to sell your faulty product. This is just not what I expected. Fine, whatever.

I understand your disappointment, and I am sorry we couldn't resolve this with a direct refund today. Our technical support team is available 24/7 if you do find the time to call them. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
